jab zameen apney bhonchal say jhanjorr-di jaye gi ,
aur zameen apney bojh bahir nikal dey gi ,
aur insan kahey ga kay iss ko kiya hogaya hai ?
uss din zameen apni sari khabren bata dey gi ,
kiyonkay tumharay perwerdigar ney ussay yehi hukum diya hoga .
uss roz log mukhtalif toliyon mein wapis hon gay , takay unn kay aemal unhen dikha diye jayen .
chunacheh jiss ney zarra barabar koi achai ki hogi , woh ussay dekhay ga ,
aur jiss ney zarra barabar koi burai ki hogi , woh ussay dekhay ga .
